data.description: A destrachan gains a +4 racial bonus on all saves against sonic attacks.  It is immune to the effects of its own destructive harmonics.  A destrachan whose sense of hearing is impaired is effectively blinded, treating all targets as if they had total concealment.
data.name: Protection from Sonics
